name: Lock-strafe
author: Keros
description: Strafe as in Going Commando: hold L2 or R2 (or always, with a weapon that fires ahead) and Ratchet faces where the camera looks while the left stick moves him; his hips turn toward where he goes while his body stays on the camera, and X with the stick pushed sideways or back flips that way. L1 still looks and R1 still crouches.

settings.name: Mode
settings.description: Lock: always with a weapon that fires ahead, Hold otherwise. Hold: only while L2 or R2 is held.

settings.name: Feel
settings.description: Going Commando: Ratchet turns to the camera when L2 or R2 goes down (the camera stays), turns and stops as in Ratchet & Clank 2, and backpedals only near straight back. Classic: the camera swings behind him, the first game's own turn rates.

settings.name: Hip twist
settings.description: Strafing, his hips and legs turn toward where he goes and his body turns back to face ahead, as in Going Commando. Needs an OpenRAC that lets mods turn the hero's joints; without it he strafes without the twist.

settings.name: Strafe flips
settings.description: Strafing, X with the stick pushed all the way left, right or back does a side flip or a back flip that way, as in Going Commando.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log for each pad report, with what the strafe does.
